verdict.rationale: Paychex states that it automatically calculates, files, and pays payroll taxes (docs-11, docs-19). It also says it handles calculation, withholding, and remittance for every state where employees work (docs-16), which covers the core of the story at the federal and state levels. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that local (city/county) taxes are filed and remitted, in-depth first-party tax-service documentation beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
